data.one_liner: Integrate OneSignal push notifications and in-app messaging into your Flutter app.
data.what_it_does: Connects your Flutter application to the OneSignal service to handle push notifications, email, SMS, and in-app messages on iOS and Android. Provides user-centric APIs for cross-channel messaging and user data management.
use_when: You need a cross-platform push notification service with built-in segmentation and in-app messaging.
You want to manage user subscriptions across multiple channels like push, email, and SMS.
avoid_when: You only need simple local device notifications without any remote backend service.
You are strictly tied to Firebase Cloud Messaging without a third-party notification wrapper.
strengths: Free push notification service with advanced segmentation and targeting features.
Supports both iOS and Android platforms with clear setup guides.
Includes in-app messaging alongside push, email, and SMS capabilities.
weaknesses: Migration to v5.x user-centric APIs may not have 1:1 feature parity with older versions yet.
Requires platform-specific configuration for APNs and FCM credentials.
data.setup_notes: Requires following the OneSignal Setup Guide for iOS and Android credentials, configuring app identifiers, and potentially handling native dependency exclusions or CocoaPods subspecs for location tracking.

alternatives.name: firebase_messaging
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer using Firebase directly for cloud messaging instead of a third-party service.
